# ChartPatternFill

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Pure-vector hatch or dot pattern fill resolved in core for monochrome/PDF/A-1 safety.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Properties

- [`background`](#background): Optional background fill colour behind the pattern.
- [`foreground`](#foreground): Pattern stroke or dot foreground colour.
- [`kind`](#kind): Pattern geometry kind.
- [`spacing`](#spacing): Spacing between pattern lines or dots in points.
- [`strokeWidth`](#strokewidth): Stroke width of pattern lines in points.
